headline: [Exclusive] Banks give only lip service to 'productive finance'… direct investment and fund contributions just 1%
summary: A report finds Korean commercial banks still focus on easy facility and working capital loans rather than investment in venture and innovative industries. Direct investment and fund contributions reportedly total just 1%.
why: Commercial banks channel credit to the economy, and their lending mix affects funding for startups and high-growth industries in Korea.
